shell.chooseWorkspaceBody: Pick the workspace you want to work in from the list above.

errors.lastOwner: The workspace's last owner cannot be removed or given another role.
errors.ownerOnly: Only an owner can do this.

errors.draftChanged: The draft changed after it was shown to you. Go through it again before approving.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to your workspace with your email and password.
login.invalid: The email or password is wrong.

register.title: Sign up
register.description: Create your account and your first workspace.

invite.title: Accept invite
invite.description: You have been invited to a workspace.
invite.signedInAs: You are signed in as {{email}}. You can accept the invite with this account.
invite.newUser: No account yet? Join by entering your name and a password.
invite.haveAccount: Already have an account with this email?
invite.signInRequired: An account with this email already exists. Sign in first to accept the invite.
invite.forbidden: This invite is not valid: it may have expired, been used, or been sent to another email address.
invite.alreadyMember: You are already a member of this workspace.
invite.accepted: Invite accepted. You have joined the workspace.

strategy.title: Waiting for a strategy
strategy.body: The strategy comes out of a consultation your agent runs with you over MCP: it asks, records your answers and its assumptions, and puts the draft up for your approval.
strategy.draftTitle: A strategy draft is being worked out
strategy.draftBody: Gaps to close before the draft can be submitted: {{count}}.
strategy.noGaps: No gaps: the draft can be submitted.
strategy.submittedWait: It takes effect once an owner or a manager approves it.

inactive.pending_payment: Your workspace becomes active once payment is received.
inactive.suspended: Your workspace is suspended. Contact us for details.

agent.title: Agent
agent.overdueBody: The agent has not checked in within the expected interval; pending work is waiting.
agent.schedulerNote: The agent's scheduler is the tenant's responsibility: Jeeta never wakes the agent; you set up the schedule that runs it at regular intervals.
agent.onTime: The agent is checking in on time.

pending.title: Pending work
pending.consult_strategy: Work out the strategy in the consultation, or continue the open draft.
pending.approve_strategy: Review and approve the submitted strategy draft.
pending.verify_capability_stale: The verification of {{name}} has lapsed; verify it again.
pending.declare_first_capability: Declare the first capability the workspace can act through.
pending.reconnect_connector: {{name}} must be reconnected: its provider no longer accepts its login.
pending.inbound_events_one: {{n}} inbound event (a message, status, lead, call or consent change) awaits your agent.
pending.inbound_events_other: {{n}} inbound events (messages, statuses, leads, calls, consent changes) await your agent.
pending.reopen_question: Decision to reopen a lost journey

team.title: Team
team.description: The workspace's members and pending invites.
team.removeBody: {{email}} will be removed from this workspace.
team.cancelInviteBody: The invite sent to {{email}} will stop working.

dialog.title: Invite member
dialog.description: An invite link is created; you pass it on to the person you invite.
dialog.linkWarning: This link is shown only now. Copy it and send it to the person you invited; once closed you cannot see it again.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: System roles are fixed; custom roles carry their own permissions.

dialog.description: Choose the permissions the role grants.
dialog.keyHint: 2–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Agents connect to this workspace with these keys.
apiKeys.revokeBody: The key {{name}} will be revoked; agents using it will no longer connect.
apiKeys.emptyBody: Create a key to connect an agent.

dialog.title: Create API key
dialog.description: Name the key and, if you like, narrow its scope.
dialog.scopesHint: If you choose none, the key carries all of your permissions.
dialog.plaintextWarning: This key is shown only now. Copy it and keep it somewhere safe; once closed you cannot see it again.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Clients that have connected to this workspace with its API keys.
agents.emptyBody: The first client to connect with an API key will show up here.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.description: Everything that happens in the workspace; agent and human actions side by side.
ledger.emptyBody: Things that happen in the workspace will show up here.

login.title: Platform sign in
login.description: Sign in as a platform operator.
login.invalid: The email or password is wrong.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.description: The workspace's approved strategy and the draft being worked out.
strategy.noApprovedBody: A draft shows here once it is approved.
strategy.noDraftBody: Your agent runs the consultation over MCP: it asks its questions, records your answers and its assumptions, writes the sections and the hypotheses, and submits the draft for your approval. You can also start the consultation here.
strategy.noGaps: No gaps: the draft can be submitted.
strategy.submitted: The draft is submitted for approval.
strategy.submitRefused: The draft could not be submitted. Gaps:
strategy.approved: The strategy is approved and in force.
strategy.approveOwnerOnly: Only an owner or a manager can approve.
strategy.approveNeedsSubmit: The draft must be submitted before it can be approved.
strategy.approveBody: Once approved, this version is the strategy in force and replaces the one before it. Go through what it rests on first.
strategy.approveNoAssumptions: No assumption was recorded: every point rests on your answers.
strategy.approveNotSubmitted: The draft was reopened meanwhile; it cannot be approved until it is submitted again.
strategy.approveNoDraft: No draft awaits approval any more; it may have been approved or closed meanwhile.
strategy.archiveBody: Version {{number}} will be archived and no strategy will be in force; work that needs a strategy stops until a new version is approved.
strategy.archiveConfirmLabel: Type the version number to confirm: {{number}}

fields.segmentKeyHint: 2–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

consultation.title: Consultation log
consultation.description: Questions, answers, assumptions and notes, newest first.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: The accounts, devices and tools the workspace can act through.
capabilities.emptyBody: A capability shows here once your agent or you declare it.

policy.label: Policy
policy.humanApproval: Every action waits for a human's approval

declareDialog.title: Declare a capability
declareDialog.description: Declare an account, a device or a tool the workspace can use. No secrets are entered here.
declareDialog.keyDetailHint: 2–40 characters: lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens.
declareDialog.externalIdHint: The provider's id of the account, page or line.
declareDialog.connectorPublicHint: Only settings that are not secret; never a password or a token.

editDialog.title: Edit {{name}}
editDialog.description: Change the name, the description or the account. The kind, the settings and the policy stay as they are.
editDialog.externalIdHint: The provider's id of the account, page or line; it cannot be emptied.
editDialog.externalIdConnectorHint: The provider's id of the account, page or line; it cannot be emptied. Changing it means connecting the account again.
editDialog.connectorWarning: Changing the account resets the verification and drops the stored credentials: connect the account again afterwards.
editDialog.savedReset: Capability updated; its verification was reset and its credentials dropped. Connect the account again.

verifyDialog.title: Verify {{name}}
verifyDialog.description: The evidence is the agent's (or your) claim; the system records it and never checks it.
verifyDialog.evidenceHint: What was run, or what was seen?
verifyDialog.refsHint: A file id, a serial number, a screenshot id…

policyDialog.title: Policy of {{name}}
policyDialog.description: When and how much the capability may act.
policyDialog.tzHint: UTC or an IANA name such as Europe/Istanbul.
policyDialog.toHint: 24 = the end of the day (midnight). A window past midnight is split over two days.
policyDialog.humanApproval: Every action waits for a human's approval

unreachableDialog.title: {{name}} is unreachable
unreachableDialog.description: Why did the last attempt fail?

retireDialog.title: Retire the capability
retireDialog.body: {{name}} will be retired: its record stays, but it can no longer be verified, grouped or linked to a budget; it leaves its groups and budget items.

linkDialog.title: Budget item for {{name}}
linkDialog.description: Choose a budget item the capability may spend from.
linkDialog.none: No budget item fits this capability.

groupsPanel.title: Capability groups
groupsPanel.description: Named sets such as a brand, a branch, a persona or a purpose; a capability may be in many groups.
groupsPanel.name: Group name
groupsPanel.deleteBody: The group {{name}} will be deleted; its members stay as capabilities.

probeDialog.title: Probe: {{name}}
probeDialog.description: The system made a small trial call to the provider with the credentials.
probeDialog.ok: The probe succeeded; the connection works.

hooks.title: Webhook addresses
hooks.description: Where the providers send this workspace's events (incoming messages, statuses, calls, consent changes). Paste each one into the provider's dashboard.
hooks.netgsmHelp: Each address carries a key of this workspace's own: paste it into the NetGSM dashboard only, and do not share it.
hooks.verifyTokenHint: The verify token is set in the dashboard of the platform's Meta app; it is not shown here.
hooks.metaMissing: The platform's Meta app is not configured yet; the Meta webhook address appears once it is.

iys.title: IYS connection (optional)
iys.body: Use the same user code as your SMS line and your IYS password to synchronize consent. Your SMS connection is preserved.
iys.first: Save the SMS line first to add its IYS connection.

mail.title: Connect an email mailbox
mail.body: Enter your SMTP and IMAP settings. The connection checks your account and sender address using TLS.
mail.name: Mailbox name

connect.title: Connect an account
connect.description: Connect your provider accounts to the workspace. For Meta and X you sign in at the provider; for NetGSM you enter your credentials.
connect.chooseKind: Choose the kind of account to connect first.
connect.noPermission: Connecting accounts needs the permission to manage capabilities.
connect.unsupported: No provider connects this kind of account yet.

oauth.title: Sign in at the provider
oauth.body: You will be taken to the provider's sign-in page. Once you have signed in and granted access, you come back to the panel and choose the accounts to connect. Sign in within ten minutes.
oauth.reconnectBody: This account's login will be renewed: sign in at the provider with the same account again.
oauth.firstBindsNote: This capability is not bound to an account yet: the first account you choose at the provider becomes this capability, and the others you choose are added as new capabilities.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.body: They are stored sealed and never shown again; the connection is probed as soon as they are saved.
credentials.name: Capability name
credentials.nameHint: Shown under this name in the panel and in the list the agent reads.
credentials.msgheaderHint: The approved sender name at NetGSM.

token.body: You can also connect by pasting an access token you got from the provider. The token is sealed and never shown again.
token.externalIdHint: The provider's id of the page or the WhatsApp phone number.

result.verified: The connection was probed and verified.
result.failed: The credentials were saved, but the probe failed: {{reason}}.
result.pending: The credentials were saved; the connection is not verified yet.

oauthCallback.title: Account connection
oauthCallback.chooseBody: Below are the assets the account you signed in with reaches. The ones you choose are added as capabilities and probed at once.
oauthCallback.firstBinds: This connection was started for a capability: the first account you choose becomes that capability, and the others are added as new capabilities.
oauthCallback.none: This account reaches nothing that can be connected.
oauthCallback.errorTitle: The connection could not be completed
oauthCallback.providerDenied: Access was not granted at the provider; no account was connected.
oauthCallback.providerError: The provider did not complete the connection.
oauthCallback.missingParams: This page was opened without the provider's answer.
oauthCallback.unknownCallback: The panel does not know this return address; start connecting again from the panel.
oauthCallback.stateRefused: This connection request does not belong to this workspace, has expired or was already used. Start connecting again.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: The workspace's own money and caps: ad budget, SMS, agent quota, consumables.
budget.emptyBody: Create an item such as an ad budget, SMS or an agent quota; the agent records what it spends here.

dialog.title: Create a budget item
dialog.description: The item's kind decides the unit it is counted in.
dialog.currencyHint: An ISO 4217 code such as TRY.

editDialog.title: Edit {{name}}
editDialog.description: Change the name, the cap or the period; the kind and the unit stay. A cap below what was already spent is allowed: the item then reads over its cap.

retireDialog.title: Retire the budget item
retireDialog.body: {{name}} will stop taking links and spend: every capability linked to it is unlinked. Its spend history stays.

spendSheet.title: {{name}}: spend
spendSheet.description: Newest first; a spend record is never deleted.
spendSheet.retired: This item is retired: it takes no more spend.
spendSheet.referenceHint: An invoice number, a campaign id…

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Reply to conversations and manage journeys and follow-ups.
inbox.noConversations: This person has no conversations yet.

fence.reply_window_closed: The reply window for this channel has closed.
fence.journey_lost: This journey is lost. An authorized person must reopen it before replying.
fence.person_erased: Replies are blocked because this person’s data was erased.
fence.person_merged: This person was merged into another record.
fence.executor_changed: The executor changed. Refresh the conversation.
fence.human_holds_conversation: A human holds the conversation; agent sending is blocked.
fence.owner_or_manager_required: Only an owner or manager can reopen a journey.
fence.terminal: This journey is terminal; the event cannot be applied.
fence.undo_expired: The merge undo window has expired.
fence.edited_after_merge: The keeper changed, so this merge cannot be undone.
fence.two_open_journeys: Resolve one of the two open journeys before merging.
fence.workspace_inactive: Sending is blocked because the workspace is inactive.
fence.unsupported_reply_channel: This channel does not support replies.
fence.connector_unavailable: The channel connector is currently unavailable.

merges.title: Merges
merges.confirmHint: This restores the moved records. Type “{{phrase}}” to confirm.
